  • Method Details

    • parameterizedType

      static Optional<ParameterizedType> parameterizedType(Class<?> clazz)
      Traverses the class hierarchy of the given class to find the first ParameterizedType. This is useful for finding generic superclass information.
      Parameters:
      clazz - the class to inspect.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the first ParameterizedType found, or an empty Optional if none is found.

    • erasureOf

      static Optional<Class<?>> erasureOf(Type t)
      Gets the raw Class for a given Type. This utility method handles various Type subtypes like Class, ParameterizedType, GenericArrayType, TypeVariable, and WildcardType.
      Parameters:
      t - the type to get the erasure of. Can be null.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the raw class, or an empty Optional if the erasure cannot be determined or the input is null.
